title: Fourier coefficients of reindexed restrictions
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $J\subseteq[n]$, fix a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$, and let $e:[k]\to J$ be a bijection. For any real-valued function $p$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$ and any $S\subseteq[k]$, the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the restriction with free coordinates reindexed by $e$ equals the Fourier coefficient, on the restricted cube, at $e(S)$ with the fixed assignment $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
